issues.description: The problem statement asks students to implement a function named _construct_zero_state_prep_circuit(...), but both the template and the solution define the function as construct_zero_state_prep_circuit(...) (no leading underscore). This name mismatch can confuse students about which function to implement or test against.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the function name consistent across artifacts. Either update the problem statement to request construct_zero_state_prep_circuit(...) (remove the leading underscore) or rename the function in the template and solution to _construct_zero_state_prep_circuit(...). Ensure tests reference the chosen name.
